name: AWS Free Tier
title: AWS Free Tier — up to $200 credits for 6 months (new customers)
eligibility: New AWS customers get $100 in credits at signup and can earn up to $100 more; the free plan lasts 6 months or until credits run out; 30+ services stay always-free within monthly limits.

name: Azure Free Account
title: Azure free account — $200 credit for 30 days + free services
eligibility: New Azure customers; a credit or debit card is needed for identity verification (a temporary USD 1 hold may apply); 20+ services free for 12 months and 65+ always-free services.

name: Lovable
title: Lovable free plan — 5 daily build credits (up to 30/month)
eligibility: Free plan: 5 build credits a day (up to 30 a month) plus 20 monthly Cloud credits; a student discount is available with a university email.

name: Spotify Premium
title: Spotify Premium Standard — 2 months for ₹139 (new users)
eligibility: Only if you haven't tried Premium before; Premium Standard only; renews at 139 rupees a month after 2 months; cancel anytime.

name: Spotify Premium
title: Spotify Premium Student — 2 months for ₹69, then ₹69/month
eligibility: Students enrolled in an eligible accredited higher-education institution; not available if you have already tried Premium.

name: YouTube Premium
title: YouTube Premium — free trial on monthly plans (new members)
eligibility: Free trial for eligible new members only on monthly plans; plans start at 149 rupees a month; restrictions apply.
